sources.title: patina: Image-to-Image model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview patina is an image-to-image model that extracts physically-based rendering (PBR) material maps from photographs, generating seamless high-resolution normal, roughness, basecolor (albedo), height (displacement), and metalness maps suitable for 3D asset creation.
